contract:
FOLD THIS SIGNAL (plain text, no em-dashes, under 150 words): the row below is a signal an estate captured. Answer three things only: (1) TRUE-TODAY: is this signal still true given everything else you know in the row's context - yes/no/unknown with one line of why; (2) THE ORGAN: which kind of organ should own this signal (a law, a clock, a gate, a memory row, or compost); (3) THE FALSIFIER: the observation that would prove the signal wrong. Mark unknowns UNKNOWN; do not pad.

SIGNAL: CONTEXT: Requested: a comms protocol that is (a) decodable only by holders of a shared codebook, (b) indistinguishable from noise/innocuous traffic to outsiders, (c) authorship-verifiable by legitimate key-holders. Core tension: *publicly transferable* proof of authorship contradicts deniability — no scheme can give both. Resolution adopted: scope ALL cryptographic power (decrypt, verify, attribute, forge) to the single shared secret; outsiders get nothing, insiders get everything including forgery power — which is precisely what makes authorship deniable outside the group. ROLE: Protocol desi
